name: Dakkajet
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Dakkajet model. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Armoured Impact; 2 Dual Supa-shoota.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
_wargearOptions_note: Printed as: This model can be equipped with 1 Dual Supa-shoota. The model starts with 2 Dual Supa-shootas (carriedBy says so); the option adds a third.
